ValidationRule.description: If “Lead Source” equals 'Referral - Agency', then both Referral Primary and Referral Secondary must be completed
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(LeadSource, "Referral - Agency"), OR( ISBLANK(Referral_Detail__c), ISBLANK(Referral_Secondary__c) ) ) && NOT($Permission.BypassValidationRules) && NOT( $User.Id = '0053b00000CSZR6')
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please populate 'Referral Primary' and 'Referral Secondary' when Lead Source = 'Referral - Agency'
